source: standalone prototype, not the existing Komorebi library
negative_controls: Naive claim 'obstruction dimension always equals number of menu items needed' is false
Finite menu cannot always repair a nonzero obstruction
No legal repair when a preserved functional detects the residual
Vanishing transported obstruction does NOT imply vanishing source obstruction without injectivity
Nonzero first-order obstruction need not forbid a nonlinear solution
Zero linear obstruction does not guarantee a global nonlinear solution
Singular mod-2 root does NOT lift mod 4 (genuine next-depth obstruction)
Root-of-unity normalized averaging undefined if characteristic divides projector order
All local edges invertible but global gluing fails
Overestimating a weight creates a false congruence certificate
Claiming p^3 congruence after omitting a term of weight p^2 is invalid
Trivial scalar marking does not reproduce the required nontrivial projective commutator
Linearized cokernel is nonzero yet an exact nonlinear solution exists within distance 0.01
